TaskDescription: Reaching game: the child guides a game object with one finger along a curved path on an upright iPad, which logs the position of the object (the end-effector trajectory); a session has 3 rounds of 4 trials, and the hand usually alternates every two trials (hand column of beh.tsv).

run.Description: Run label: trial order within the session, run = (round - 1) x 4 + trial of the round; 3 game rounds of 4 trials per session.

trial_start.Description: Start of the trial (path appears), session time: seconds since the first trial start of the session.

movement_start.Description: First end-effector sample, session time: seconds since the first trial start of the session.

movement_end.Description: Last end-effector sample, session time: seconds since the first trial start of the session.

path_length.Description: Length of the end-effector trajectory on the screen (sum of the distances between consecutive samples of the ipad motion file).

n_object_touches.Description: Number of object_touch_begin events of the trial (trajectory file). A touch already on the screen when the trial starts has no begin event, so 0 is common although the object was moved.

n_other_touches.Description: Number of other_touch_begin events of the trial (touches that began elsewhere on the screen, trajectory file).
